sections.title: 1. Definition of personal information
sections.body: Personal information refers to information about a living individual that can identify the individual through items such as name, date of birth, or other descriptions.

sections.title: 2. Collection methods
sections.body: We may collect personal information via contact forms, email, or phone. Collected items include name, email, phone number, and company name.

sections.title: 3. Purposes of use
sections.body: We use collected personal information for:

sections.title: 4. Third-party disclosure
sections.body: We do not disclose personal information to third parties without your consent, except as required by law.

sections.title: 5. Security measures
sections.body: We take appropriate security measures to prevent leakage, loss, or damage of personal information.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.body: This site may use cookies for usage analysis and service improvement.

sections.title: 7. Disclosure / correction / deletion
sections.body: You may request disclosure, correction, or deletion of your personal information. Please contact us at the address below.

sections.title: 8. Policy changes
sections.body: We may revise this policy as needed. The updated policy takes effect on publication on this site.
